headline: Govt declares Nov 7 as a general holiday for National Revolution and Solidarity Day
summary: The decision was approved during a cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman on Monday.
details: The Bangladesh government has declared November 7 as a general holiday every year to mark the 'National Revolution and Solidarity Day'.
The proposal was approved during a cabinet meeting held at the Secretariat on Monday, chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
According to a press release from the Cabinet Division, November 7 will now be observed as a general holiday annually.
The day will be categorized as a 'Category A' day in the circular regarding the celebration of national and international days issued by the Cabinet Division.
caption:
Mark your calendars! November 7 is now a general holiday in Bangladesh.

The Bangladesh government has declared November 7 as a general holiday every year to mark the 'National Revolution and Solidarity Day'.

The proposal was approved during a cabinet meeting held at the Secretariat on Monday, chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

According to a press release from the Cabinet Division, November 7 will now be observed as a general holiday annually.

The day will be categorized as a 'Category A' day in the circular regarding the celebration of national and international days issued by the Cabinet Division.

headline_marked: 9 die in 24 hours as [[dengue death toll rises to 271]] this year
headline: 9 die in 24 hours as dengue death toll rises to 271 this year
summary: Over 1,900 patients were admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh in a single day, marking a sharp increase in fatalities.
details: Nine people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, according to a press release from the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
During the same period, 1,902 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.
The regional breakdown of admissions shows 401 patients in Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 306 in Khulna, 272 in Chittagong, and 216 in Barishal.
Within the capital, 206 patients were admitted in Dhaka North City Corporation and 223 in Dhaka South City Corporation.
Other admissions included 105 in Rajshahi, 98 in Mymensingh, 66 in Rangpur, and 9 in Sylhet.
This brings the total number of dengue deaths for the current year to 271, with a total of 88,360 people hospitalized for the virus.
caption:
9 deaths in just 24 hours. Dengue fatalities in Bangladesh have reached 271 this year.

Nine people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, according to a press release from the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

During the same period, 1,902 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.

The regional breakdown of admissions shows 401 patients in Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 306 in Khulna, 272 in Chittagong, and 216 in Barishal.

Within the capital, 206 patients were admitted in Dhaka North City Corporation and 223 in Dhaka South City Corporation.

Other admissions included 105 in Rajshahi, 98 in Mymensingh, 66 in Rangpur, and 9 in Sylhet.

This brings the total number of dengue deaths for the current year to 271, with a total of 88,360 people hospitalized for the virus.
